title: (authz) Gate POST /diag/rangetest behind OSCORE/local-admin at dispatch
description: AUDIT (epic 6mij decomposition): lichen_rangetest_post_handler (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:729-763) calls coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request() but NEVER checks oscore.is_protected or lichen_coap_is_local_admin(). Any unauthenticated mesh peer can POST /diag/rangetest (spec/12-apps.md:885, Kconfig LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST) and force extended radio transmissions -> airtime/energy DoS on a battery mesh. Violates epic policy (ALL mutating CoAP resources gated at dispatch) and spec/06-security.md 8.7 (OSCORE for all CoAP traffic); spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3 puts diagnostics under restricted access. FIX: apply the landed house pattern (w063) used by coap_config.c:738-757 and coap_dtn.c:112-123: after unprotect, 'if (!oscore.is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin(addr, addr_len)) return coap_oscore_respond_resource(..., COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_UNAUTHORIZED, 0, NULL, 0);'. ACCEPTANCE: (1) unprotected+non-admin POST returns 4.01 via coap_oscore_respond_resource and performs no radio activity; (2) OSCORE-protected valid POST returns 2.05 SenML pack; (3) plain request from local admin returns 2.05; (4) tests added under lichen/tests/coap_rangetest asserting all three paths using the stubbed is_local_admin pattern of lichen/tests/coap_config/src/main.c:146.
close_reason: POST /diag/rangetest now enforces the house authz gate at dispatch (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_rangetest.c:746-757, after coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request): if (!oscore.is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin(addr, addr_len)) return 4.01 UNAUTHORIZED via coap_oscore_respond_resource before any decode/encode/transmit, so an unauthenticated mesh peer can no longer force extended radio transmissions (airtime/energy DoS). Spec check per acceptance: spec/12-apps.md 18.7 defines only the wire format and mandates no alternative authz; spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3 places diagnostics under restricted access levels; spec/06-security.md 8.8 mandates OSCORE for CoAP — house pattern (OSCORE-protected OR local-admin) is consistent, no contradiction, no escalation filed. Declaration source: lichen_coap_is_local_admin via <lichen/coap_server.h> (same as coap_config.c). Tests (lichen/tests/coap_rangetest/src/main.c): added stub lichen_coap_is_local_admin + oscore_protected/admin_result knobs (authorized defaults in init_provider keep all pre-existing cases green) and new ZTEST post_requires_oscore_or_local_admin covering: unprotected+non-admin POST -> 4.01 with zero-length response (no SenML emitted, no radio activity) and no mutation; OSCORE-protected POST -> 2.05 SenML; local-admin plain POST -> 2.05 SenML. Twister qemu_x86/atom: 1/1 configurations passed, 11/11 test cases passed (10 pre-existing all green + 1 new), outdir /Volumes/Attic/tmp/twister-rangetest-authz. Commit a08907faa1 (fix(coap): gate rangetest POST behind authz).
